versions.content: The cable diagnostic APIs ( EthSwt_RunPortCableDiag- nostic , EthSwt_GetPortCableDiagnosticsResult ) shall only be called for Eth- ernet switch ports of a Ethernet switch, where the Ethernet switch ports reference an Ethernet transceiver.
